product.name: LOLM
product.tagline: An agent that does not lose the plot.
product.description: LOLM keeps explicit task state, runs work in a sandbox, verifies completion, and produces a receipt showing what happened.

hierarchy.LOLM agent: User-facing persistent agent with task state, sandbox execution, verification, and receipts
hierarchy.NFET: Technical control and telemetry subsystem within LOLM (not a separate consumer product)
hierarchy.Latent Order Language Model: Research architecture and model family — see architecture/research pages
hierarchy.Receipts: Evidence and audit layer for runs

free.label: Free
free.blurb: Evaluate every day — no card required

pro.label: Pro
pro.blurb: Heavy use under a typical $20 AI plan

billing.checkout: Stripe hosted Checkout; server sets prices from plan config

topups.note: One-time top-up packs are not live yet. Upgrade Plus/Pro or self-host for more capacity.

models.policy: Do not hard-code a permanent generator model brand promise. Hosted inference uses a provider cascade that can change with availability.
models.controller: LOLM task-state control, verification, and receipts
models.receipts: When allowed, each run receipt should expose the actual provider and model used
models.demo_wording: Hosted demo uses the current available generator; LOLM provides task control and receipts — not a fixed model size guarantee

experimental: Real multi-hour coding superiority is not claimed as proven
Model quality depends on the selected generator
